stories.title: Two software stocks face a test of whether their rallies can hold
stories.summary: CNBC says two software stocks it tracks are nearing a key test of whether their recent share-price rallies are justified. The report does not name the two stocks or set out the exact catalyst.
stories.whyItMatters: Software stocks are a bellwether for tech valuations, so a failed rally test could signal broader risk in the sector.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of which two stocks CNBC means
The next earnings or guidance update from each company

stories.title: Options traders pile into bets that the bond rout is ending
stories.summary: CNBC reports that options markets show a heavy build-up of bets on a bond market rally. The positioning suggests some traders think the recent bond sell-off, known as the rout, is close to reversing.
stories.whyItMatters: Bond yields set borrowing costs and shape equity valuations, so a shift in the rout matters across the whole market.
whatToWatch: Movement in Treasury yields in coming sessions
Any Fed comments that could confirm or deny the rally bet
questions: What is driving the bet on a bond rally?
Will yields actually reverse, or is this a hedge?

sources.title: Bond rout ending? Massive bets on bond rally dominate options market

stories.title: Dick's Sporting Goods stock falls 30% after earnings miss, cites weak footwear demand
stories.summary: Dick's Sporting Goods shares dropped 30% after the retailer missed earnings expectations. The company pointed to a "challenging" footwear market as a factor.
stories.whyItMatters: The drop signals possible stress in consumer discretionary spending, and footwear weakness can spill over to suppliers.
whatToWatch: Any updated guidance from Dick's Sporting Goods
Earnings from peer retailers in the same category
questions: Is the weakness specific to footwear, or a broader consumer pullback?
How will suppliers respond to the reported softness?

sources.title: Dick's Sporting Goods stock falls 30% as retailer misses expectations, cites 'challenging' footwear market

stories.title: Options traders bet on the quietest Nvidia earnings reaction in years
stories.summary: MarketWatch reports that options markets are pricing in the smallest expected stock move for Nvidia after earnings in years. Some see the low expected volatility as a possible opportunity for AI bulls if results surprise.
stories.whyItMatters: Nvidia's earnings are a bellwether for AI-driven market gains, so low expected volatility could mean the market is underpricing a surprise.
whatToWatch: Whether the actual stock reaction matches the muted options pricing
questions: Why do traders expect such a quiet reaction this time?
What would trigger a bigger move than priced in?

sources.title: Options traders are betting on the quietest Nvidia earnings reaction in years. It could be an opportunity for AI bulls.
